changelog: Fixed long-presses on channels sometimes not registering (a periodic refresh could interrupt the gesture mid-press). Fixed Multi-View and Mosaic showing a stream as solid white instead of video. Fixed Mosaic playing every tile's audio at once on open. Fixed TV's channel-number entry to use the real channel number and work from anywhere. Fixed the TV sidebar auto-collapsing mid-browse instead of only after real idle time. Re-selecting a TV sidebar tab now jumps straight to whatever's currently playing. The Guide tab's long-press now offers Remind Me/Record This everywhere, consistently.
